name: How does AKN Design Group's integrated design-build approach differ from traditional contractors?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group's integrated design-build approach differ from traditional contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group's integrated design-build approach unifies design planning and construction under a single, accountable team, providing a managed process from concept to completion. Unlike traditional methods where homeowners manage separate designers and contractors, our model streamlines communication, minimizes potential for miscommunication, and ensures the design vision translates directly into construction execution. This single point of coordination enhances overall project efficiency, simplifies the homeowner experience, and delivers a cohesive, customized renovation with a focus on craftsmanship and clear communication, avoiding the complexities of navigating multiple vendors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our integrated design-build process unifies design and construction under one team, streamlining communication and ensuring a managed process from concept to completion, unlike traditional fragmented approaches.
